Name: The Fishmonger - Custom NPC
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/8cz6XGbf/Constance-Location1.png[/img]
﻿
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
[size=3]Meet Constance, a fishmonger* who made her home on Ginger Island. She is located right at the docks where her boat stays all seasons. You're welcomed to drop by any time, there's no such thing as a curfew or locked doors in her vacabulary. Maybe a bit rough around the edges at first, but you'll soon realize that she is not as stoic and serious as she first appeared.
There's also quite a good amount of fish puns, so I hope you bring a sense of humor.

[b]Currently includes:[/b] some events(intro, 2 hearts and 4 hearts), full seasonal dialogue, gift/movie tastes, a shop, letters...more are to follow in future updates!

I do NOT consent to any NSFW mods being made of any of my NPCs in this mod. Please respect my wishes.

[i]Planned future features include but are not limited to: more events, another custom NPC,  a series of quests.[/i][/size]

[size=1]*I am aware a female fishmonger is called a fishwife but that...kinda sounded too silly so she's a fishmonger, yeah.[/size]

[size=1][img]https://i.postimg.cc/VsKMrSYq/Constance-banner1.png[/img][/size]
[size=3][b]Constance - The Fishmonger[/b]
[b]Loves[/b]: Lava Eel, Super Cucumber, Lucky Lunch, Sea Urchin, Fire Opal, Fried Calamari, Green Tea, Tea Leaves
[b]Likes[/b]: Fire Quartz, Dried Starfish, Rainbow Trout, Fiddlefern Head, Rainbow Shell, Kyanite, Eel
[b]Hates[/b]: Trash, Void Mayonnaise, Holly, Trilobite[/size]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
[size=3] - Install the latest version of SMAPI, Content Patcher and Custom Companions.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
[size=3]
Technically compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿ as Ginger Island isn't really changed much in that area by SVE! Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12285]The Submarine[/url]﻿ mod thanks to the mod makers efforts. ﻿Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15939]lnh's Ginger island Overhaul[/url]﻿(Version 1.1.3+)![/size]
